TwoFactor.Setup.Heading: Set up two-factor authentication
TwoFactor.Setup.Subtitle: Pair an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.) to add a second sign-in factor to your account.
TwoFactor.Setup.Step1Body: Use any TOTP-compatible app on your phone or desktop.
TwoFactor.Setup.Step2Body: Open your authenticator app and scan the code below. If your app cannot scan, type the key by hand.
TwoFactor.Setup.Step3Body: Once paired, your app shows a six-digit code that rotates every 30 seconds. Enter the current code below to enable two-factor.
TwoFactor.Setup.KeyRotated: Authenticator key rotated. Re-pair your app with the new QR code.
TwoFactor.Setup.AlreadyEnabled: Two-factor authentication is already enabled on your account.
TwoFactor.Setup.Error.CodeRequired: Enter the six-digit verification code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.Setup.Error.CodeInvalid: That verification code is invalid or expired. Try the latest code from your app.
TwoFactor.Setup.Error.ResetFailed: Failed to rotate the authenticator key.
TwoFactor.Setup.Error.NoKey: Could not generate an authenticator key. Refresh the page or contact support.
TwoFactor.Verify.Heading: Two-factor verification
TwoFactor.Verify.Subtitle: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.CodeRequired: Enter the verification code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.CodeInvalid: That code is invalid or expired. Try the latest code from your app.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.RecoveryRequired: Enter one of your recovery codes.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.RecoveryInvalid: That recovery code is invalid or has already been used. Try a different one or use your authenticator app instead.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.Locked: This account is locked. Contact an administrator.
TwoFactor.Verify.Error.NotAllowed: Sign-in is not allowed for this account yet.
TwoFactor.Recovery.Heading: Recovery codes
TwoFactor.Recovery.Subtitle: Recovery codes let you sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. Each code works once.
TwoFactor.Recovery.NotEnabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled yet. Set it up first.
TwoFactor.Recovery.OneTimeWarning: Save these codes now — they are shown only once. Store them in a password manager or print them.
TwoFactor.Recovery.CopyAria: Copy this recovery code to the clipboard
TwoFactor.Recovery.GeneratedNotice: Your recovery codes are ready. Save them now — they will not be shown again.
TwoFactor.Recovery.RegeneratedNotice: A fresh batch of recovery codes was generated. Previous codes no longer work.
TwoFactor.Recovery.DisableHint: Disabling two-factor clears your authenticator key. You can re-enroll any time from the setup page.
TwoFactor.Recovery.Error.NotEnabled: Two-factor authentication must be enabled before generating recovery codes.
TwoFactor.Recovery.Error.GenerateFailed: Failed to generate recovery codes. Try again.
